title: Complaint of RE Byung Han Yoo vs. Korean Northwest Presbytery
disposition_detail: Complaint found out of order as not timely filed under BCO 43-2: the complained-of action was taken October 10, 2000, but the complaint was filed March 12, 2001, well outside the 30-day period. No ruling on the merits.
first_summary: The SJC found the complaint of RE Byung Han Yoo against Korean Northwest Presbytery out of order because it was untimely. The challenged presbytery action was taken October 10, 2000, and the complaint was filed March 12, 2001, beyond the 30-day period of BCO 43-2. No merits ruling was reached.
summary: A ruling elder's complaint against Korean Northwest Presbytery was found out of order because it was untimely under BCO 43-2. The action complained of was taken October 10, 2000, but the complaint was filed March 12, 2001, well outside the 30-day filing period, so the SJC reached no merits question. The case illustrates that a complaint failing BCO 43-2 timeliness is dismissed without adjudication of the underlying presbytery action.
